rationale: Neither candidate surfaces the one real reviewer concern (the VoxCPM2 regression follow-up ask), so recall is ~0 for both; both did solid, well-grounded tracing of the seed→tts_local_seed→per-row-generator mechanism. Y's APPROVE verdict and non-blocking framing better match the actual outcome (a plain LGTM), and it correctly flags the stage-1 seed removal as harmless/inert rather than treating it as an equal finding like X does. X is more actionable with concrete suggested comment text and a specific test-file line, but its COMMENT verdict and three separate 'add a comment/test' asks overstate what this trivial, already-correct 2-line diff warranted.
